title: Simulator Z
description:
Zombie Simulator Z is a large-scale sandbox simulation where you control the outbreak, command survivors, and watch entire battles unfold.

Create your own zombie apocalypse by placing humans, zombies, military units, vehicles, defenses, and environmental objects throughout the world. Build fortified survivor camps, unleash massive hordes, stage military battles, or simply experiment and see who survives.

Every unit has its own role. Civilians flee from danger, soldiers fight back, medics support survivors, vehicles move troops across the battlefield, and specialized zombies bring new threats to every simulation. Both sides continue fighting and reacting even when they are outside your camera view.

Freeplay ModeFreeplay gives you complete control over the simulation. Build settlements, place barricades, deploy armies, unleash zombies, and create your own scenarios without traditional objectives or restrictions.

Thrive ModeThrive Mode challenges you to defend a generator against increasingly dangerous waves of zombies. Spend coins to deploy survivors, construct defenses, repair the generator, and prepare between rounds. Each wave introduces stronger and faster enemies—survive for as long as you can and set a new personal record.

MultiplayerPlay together with another player and control the same living battlefield. Place units, construct defenses, move troops, and create zombie scenarios cooperatively.

Features• Large-scale battles with hundreds or thousands of active units

• Humans, zombies, heroes, vehicles, helicopters, defenses, and explosives

• Multiple zombie types with different strengths and abilities

• Complete sandbox control over your simulations

• Wave-based Thrive Mode with progression and defensive building

• Cooperative two-player multiplayer

• Day-and-night simulation

• Placeable walls, doors, lights, barricades, mines, and structures

• Unit selection and movement controls

• Fast-forward controls for large battles

• Persistent unlock progression

• Create anything from small encounters to city-wide outbreaks

There is no single correct way to play. Build a safe haven, recreate humanity’s final stand, overwhelm the world with zombies, or sit back and watch the chaos unfold.

You create the apocalypse. You decide who survives.
description_short: A world where you can create your own zombie apocalypse to your liking!
